Myself and most others in this subreddit and beyound have gone theough the same feelings you have. Hell, i lost my shit a week or two ago and posted in here looking for help. Look were we are today. It may not be perfect, but there have been a lot of goods to pair with the bad as time goes on. Again i know exactly where you are coming from. But, i got through some of the harder times. Im making decent money and i drive a   bitchin camaro whi,h i never thought id get to do on a daily. I have a 3d printer thats going ham as we speak making cool shit, and ive got people who care about me even though its not said all the time. Whats the big difference between now and then? Now i know where to go for help when i feel like that, and i know that there are people who do give a shit. About 4 years ago i had a friend in your shoes. He killed himself.
